repository_commit_note: The commit that adds this kernel; this provenance record sits on top of it, so the branch head that ships it has a later hash.
scope: Ascend 950DT GemmFP8FwdOp: all 39 manifest workload cases (DeepSeek-V3 decode and prefill projections, per-tensor and per-128-block scale grids, bias, float16 output, and the KV-cache shapes). Not a public performance receipt.

campaign.metric: arithmetic mean of raw ffts device execution interval unions
campaign.reason: Task-private protocol adapter: one profiler window carries all 25 calls instead of one window per call. The eviction and the parsed statistic are unchanged; the public default-clock receipt and the host-wide reservation are still unavailable.
campaign.workspace: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.

environment.canonical_profile_note: The maintained profile pins runtime/OPP to CANN 9.1.0 and the compiler and headers to the 9.2.0 release. This container serves 9.2.0 for every component; that deviation is recorded here instead of being rounded into one version string.

baseline.deepgemm: Not measurable in this container. DeepGEMM's Ascend FP8 NT kernel JIT-compiles against the installed CANN 9.2.0 and fails on APIs that toolkit no longer ships (ascendc_assert, pre-deprecation L0C-to-GM setters); the same package produced the grouped-GEMM baselines on 2026-10-27, so the failure is in the toolchain pairing.
baseline.vendor_ops: No torch_npu or ACLNN entry point takes FP8 activations.

replay.entry_point: task replay script over benchmarks.api cases, fp8-safe input preservation (bitwise uint8 view)
replay.result: 39 of 39 manifest cases verified, source fingerprint unchanged
replay.guard: scripts/npu_guard.py with /dev/davinci0 remapped to /dev/davinci1 for this site
replay.harness_note: The shared preservation check compares every input with torch.isclose, which this torch_npu build does not implement for float8_e4m3fn; the replay compares FP8 inputs bitwise.
replay.receipt: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.

verification.tolerances: The shared workload numeric policy: atol 2e-2 * sqrt(max(1, K/1024)), rtol 2e-2.
